sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer;
SELECT Name FROM Artist WHERE ArtistId IN (SELECT ArtistId FROM Album GROUP BY ArtistId HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Album))

SELECT FirstName, LastName, COUNT(*) AS CustomerCount
FROM Employee
JOIN Customer ON Employee.SupportRepId = Customer.SupportRepId
GROUP BY FirstName, LastName
ORDER BY FirstName, LastName;

SELECT ArtistId, Name
FROM Artist
JOIN Track ON Artist.ArtistId = Track.ArtistId
JOIN Genre ON Track.GenreId = Genre.GenreId
JOIN PlaylistTrack ON Track.TrackId = PlaylistTrack.TrackId
JOIN Playlist ON PlaylistTrack.PlaylistId = Playlist.PlaylistId
JOIN MediaType ON PlaylistMediaType.MediaTypeId = PlaylistMediaType.MediaTypeId
WHERE Track.Milliseconds > 0
GROUP BY ArtistId, Name
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;

SELECT InvoiceDate, Total
FROM Invoice
JOIN InvoiceLine ON Invoice.InvoiceId = InvoiceLine.InvoiceId
JOIN Track ON InvoiceLine.TrackId = Track.TrackId
JOIN Artist ON Track.Composer = Artist.Name
JOIN Customer ON Track.CustomerId = Customer.CustomerId
JOIN Employee ON Track.EmployeeId = Employee.EmployeeId
JOIN Genre ON Track.GenreId = Genre.GenreId
JOIN PlaylistTrack ON PlaylistTrack.PlaylistId = Playlist.TrackId
JOIN Playlist ON Playlist.TrackId = PlaylistTrack.TrackId
JOIN PlaylistTrack ON Playlist.TrackId = PlaylistTrack.TrackId
JOIN Playlist ON Playlist.TrackId = PlaylistTrack.TrackId
JOIN PlaylistTrack ON Playlist.TrackId = PlaylistTrack.TrackId
JOIN Playlist ON Playlist.TrackId = PlaylistTrack.TrackId
JOIN PlaylistTrack ON Playlist.TrackId = PlaylistTrack.TrackId
JOIN Playlist ON Playlist.TrackId = PlaylistTrack.TrackId
JOIN PlaylistTrack ON Playlist.TrackId = PlaylistTrack.TrackId
JOIN Playlist ON Playlist.TrackId = PlaylistTrack.TrackId

JOIN Playlist ON Playlist.TrackId = PlaylistTrack.TrackId

SELECT year, population, gdp_usd, gdp_per_capita_usd, life_expectancy_years, fertility_rate, urban_population_pct, internet_users_pct, unemployment_pct
FROM countries
JOIN country_stats ON countries.iso3 = country_stats.iso3
ORDER BY year;

SELECT income_group, gdp_usd
FROM countries
JOIN country_stats ON countries.iso3 = country_stats.iso3
WHERE year = 2023
ORDER BY gdp_usd DESC;

SELECT iso3
FROM countries
WHERE iso3 IN (
    SELECT iso3
    FROM country_stats
    WHERE year = 2010 AND internet_users_pct < 10
    AND iso3 IN (
        SELECT iso3
        FROM country_stats
        WHERE year = 2023 AND internet_users_pct > 50
    )
)
SELECT AVG(flipper_length_mm) FROM penguins;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM penguins WHERE body_mass_g > (SELECT AVG(body_mass_g) FROM penguins) AND species != 'male' AND species != 'female';
SELECT MAX(MPG) FROM cars_data WHERE Cylinders = 8 AND Year < 1980;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employee;

SELECT loser_age, winner_age
FROM matches
GROUP BY loser_age, winner_age
HAVING 1;

SELECT semester_name FROM Semesters WHERE semester_id IN (SELECT semester_id FROM Student_Enrolment_Courses WHERE course_id IN (SELECT course_id FROM Student_Enrolment_Courses WHERE course_id IN (SELECT course_id FROM Student_Enrolment_Courses WHERE course_id IN (SELECT course_id FROM Student_Enrolment_Courses WHERE course_id IN (SELECT course_id FROM Student_Enrolment_Courses WHERE course_id IN (SELECT course_id FROM Student_Enrolment_Courses)))))) AND semester_name IS NULL;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM people;

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM country WHERE CountryCode IN (SELECT Code FROM countrylanguage WHERE Language = 'English' OR Language = 'Dutch') AND CountryCode IN (SELECT Code FROM countrylanguage WHERE Language = 'English' OR Language = 'Dutch');

SELECT first_name
FROM Owners
WHERE first_name NOT IN (
    SELECT owner_id
    FROM Dogs
    WHERE name = Owners.owner_id
)
